# Instructions live in CLAUDE.md

`../CLAUDE.md` is the single instruction surface for every agent and editor here, and states every
rule once. [../docs/index.md](../docs/index.md) lists every page: the measured facts in
`docs/lore/laws.md`, what to run in `docs/ops/runbook.md`, the task in
`docs/brief/ding/project-brief.md`. This file carries no rule of its own.
